protocol_scope.protocol_version: Drop-seq laboratory protocol v1.1 (2015-08-06) / Macosko et al. Cell 2015

states.name: Cellular polyadenylated mRNA released by droplet lysis
properties: released within seconds of droplet formation by the lysis buffer

states.name: mRNA hybridized to the barcoded bead oligo-dT primer
properties: one bead and one cell per productive droplet

states.name: mRNA:first-strand cDNA hybrid with untemplated 3' CCC
properties: formed in bulk after droplet breakage
STAMP: single-cell transcriptome attached to a microparticle

strands.name: first-strand cDNA extended from the bead primer

segments.role: untemplated deoxycytidines added by MMLV terminal transferase activity

states.name: Template-switched full-length first-strand cDNA
properties: carries the ISPCR/TSO handle at both ends, enabling single-primer amplification

segments.role: TSO-derived PCR handle acquired by template switching

states.name: Amplified double-stranded whole-transcriptome cDNA
states.physical_state: in solution after PCR and AMPure purification

states.name: Tagmented 3'-end cDNA fragment carrying the s7 Nextera adapter
states.physical_state: in solution after tagmentation and neutralization
properties: 9-nt gap left by Tn5 strand transfer, filled during the subsequent PCR
only the 3'-end fragment carrying s7 is amplifiable by P5-TSO_Hybrid + Nextera N7xx

segments.role: cDNA copy of the transcript 3' end
non-transferred mosaic-end strand annealed across the junction
Nextera s7 primer entry point (single-stranded arm)
9-nt region opposite the top-strand tagmentation gap

states.name: Final indexed Drop-seq sequencing library
properties: sequenced with a custom Read 1 primer (20 bp), 8-bp i7 index read and 50-60 bp Read 2

major_reagents.name: Drop-seq lysis buffer (Ficoll PM-400, Sarkosyl, EDTA, Tris, DTT)

transitions.operation_detail: Cells and barcoded beads are co-encapsulated in ~1 nL droplets; the lysis buffer releases mRNA within seconds and the polyA tail hybridizes to the bead oligo-dT30.

Droplets are broken with perfluorooctanol in 6X SSC and the beads washed; reverse transcription is performed in bulk (30 min room temperature, 90 min at 42 C). The terminal transferase activity of Maxima H- adds untemplated deoxycytidines at the cDNA 3' end.

major_reagents.name: Template Switch Oligo (2.5 uM in the RT mix)

transitions.operation_detail: Template switching: the TSO anneals through its 3' riboguanosines to the untemplated CCC and is copied, appending the TSO-derived PCR handle to the cDNA 3' end. Exonuclease I then removes bead primers that did not capture an RNA, followed by TE-SDS/TE-TW/water washes.

Single-primer semi-suppressive whole-transcriptome PCR on bead-bound STAMPs (95 C 3 min; 4 cycles 98/65/72; 8-13 cycles 98/67/72; final extension), followed by 0.6x AMPure XP purification, pooling and BioAnalyzer quantification.

major_reagents.name: Nextera XT Amplicon Tagment Mix (Tn5 transposome)
Nextera TD buffer / Neutralize Tagment buffer

transitions.operation_detail: 600 pg of amplified cDNA is tagmented with the Nextera XT transposome (55 C, 5 min) and neutralized. Tagmentation yields 5'-end and 3'-end fragments carrying either the s5 or s7 adapter; only the 3'-end fragment bearing s7 is amplifiable with the P5-TSO hybrid and Nextera N7xx primer pair, so the other three products are dead ends.

Library PCR with 200 nM P5-TSO hybrid oligo and Nextera N70x index primer (95 C 30 s; 11-12 cycles of 95/55/72; final extension), which fills the 9-nt tagmentation gap and adds P5, the i7 index and P7. Products are purified with 0.6x AMPure XP beads and quantified.
